title: Running an AI-native engineering org
description: When agentic coding goes from individual tool to org-wide default, the tool isn't the hard part...your processes are. Fiona Fung, Director of Engineering for Claude Code, walks through what broke at Anthropic (review, ownership, hiring) and the norms we had to rewrite to keep shipping.
